name: AO Guide Astrophysics Challenge
desc: The AO Guide Astrophysics Challenge (AOAC) is an international astronomy competition that tests students' knowledge in observational and theoretical astronomy. The competition consists of two main divisions: Open and Invitational. The Open division is accessible to all students worldwide, while the Invitational division is for top performers and features more challenging problems. AOAC emphasizes practical astronomy skills including data analysis, celestial mechanics, and astrophysics.
summary: International online astronomy competition testing observational and theoretical knowledge.

name: Olimpiada Națională de Astronomie și Astrofizică (ONAA)
desc: The Olimpiada Națională de Astronomie și Astrofizică (ONAA) serves as the primary selection mechanism for Romania's team to the International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics (IOAA). The competition tests theoretical knowledge, observational skills, and problem-solving abilities in astronomy and astrophysics. The competition consists of a Junior and a Senior division, with the top performers in the Senior division being selected for the national IOAA team. The ONAA is organized annually and attracts students from across Romania who are passionate about astronomy and astrophysics. The selections for writing ONAA is conducted by OJAA, Olimpiada Județeană de Astronomie și Astrofizică, which is the county-level astronomy olympiad.
summary: National astronomy olympiad for students in Romania, pathway to IOAA selection.
